name: Tokisaka Nino
source:
[spoiler]Her specialist magic is manifest her wish to the reality. At first time her magic invoked is when she wish to be Ichito's real little sister, but at the same time Ichito's parent and Mitsumi had an accident. Later she feel responsible for this event and reject Gen proposal to seal her memories about the cause of incident and her magic.

But right before the incident occur, she have a dream about Ichito sinking in Kagami country and then disappear after that. When she talk about it to Gen, he have a conviction that her blood as Tokisaka have been awakened and can access Tokisaka magic. Because she didn't want to lose Ichito, Gen make her to make a strong wish to grab Ichito remains existence and then pull up him from Kagami country before he disappear completely. [/spoiler]
